remarks: Welcome to Residence 209 at The Mill Westport, offering high-end luxury living with all the amenities of a fine custom home in the heart of downtown. With a concierge on-site and approximately 10,000 square feet of spectacular interior and exterior amenity spaces such as The Great Room & Cafe, Pool, Health & Wellness Center, Patio & Rooftop Deck, residents will enjoy carefree, 5-star living. This home features exposed stonework, 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, plus a den/dining rm.Second bedroom is interior, with no windows. The refined details include a large waterfall-edged kitchen island, linear gas fireplaces, Sub Zero and Wolf appliances, full-size washer/dryers, and up-to-date bathrooms with radiant heated master bath floors. An impressive collection of amenities brings a hotel-inspired experience to the residents. These include a beautiful and sustainably landscaped patio with 45' lap pool, a hot tub and grilling area, a health & wellness center outfitted with equipment from Peloton & Technogym, an inviting Great Room for meeting with friends and neighbors, and a common rooftop terrace with a wooded view. Unit 209 comes with 2 reserved parking spaces, one with a Telsa Charging stationCome see this great home.  More information about amenities available at The Mill Westport website.
